{{Quote|I need to find Twelve-String. Give her a talking-to about not being on hand.|Ledina Chott|<ref name="MK">''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]''</ref>}}
'''Twelve-String''' was a [[Housekeeping droid|housekeeper droid]] that served the famous pop star [[Musician/Legends|musician]] [[Ledina Chott]].<ref name="MK" /> In [[44 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: Mercy Kill]]'' to [[44 ABY]].</ref> members of [[Wraith Squadron]], a [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, infiltrated Chott's house in [[Tiara Ridge estates]] and disabled Twelve-String using a [[Scrambler/Legends|scrambler]].<ref name="MK" />
